messages.author: 168ba93d93d9d7d7
messages.subject: How to subset multiple values
parts:
How can i subset for multiple values, like:
p <- p + geom_text2(aes(subset=(node==c(2,10,90)),label=bootstrap)  (<-- this fails)

making a loop like: filter=c(2,10,90)   for (i in 1:length(filter))  p <- p + geom_text2(aes(subset=(node==filter[i]),label=bootstrap) 
displays only the last loop (=90 in this case) instead of all

Thanks!

messages.author: 168ba93d93d9d7d7
messages.subject: Re: How to subset multiple values
parts:
I found a way, however it's kinda unelegant. Maybe there is a better solution without messing with the ggplot data structure?

p$data$myfilter <- rep(0,myTreeNodeNumber)
p$data$myfilter[2,10,90] <- 1
and  than subset=(myfilter==1) to get the nodes I want

I cannot group my tree, it is already grouped by other parameters.
